property_summary: For any caller address that implements supportsToken() returning keccak256("Nu Token"), calling airDrop from that caller always succeeds and increases its tokenBalance to 20 on the reference; the mutant requiring keccak256("My Token") will cause such a caller to fail the supportsToken check and thus not get the airdrop for some fuzzed caller address (a deployed helper), so the observable tokenBalance after calling airDrop differs.
change_summary: Alter supportsToken to require a different token name so the supportsToken modifier fails for the original Bank implementation, preventing airDrop and changing the observed balance.
